dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Hmph! I am not idling away my time by napping!

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I'll have you know I am a Fatui diplomat—

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I am here on orders from his excellency to assess the situation in Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That sounds exciting, tell me more.

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: I'll tell you one thing... Mondstadt is boring! *yawn*

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Though they call it the City of Freedom...

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: There's just nothing to do here at all. How do Mondstadters put up with this place?

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Also, what's the big deal with this Barbatos guy? He's never even here!

dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: Can't compare with Her Majesty, the Tsaritsa of the Zapolyarny Palace... Ugh, never mind, that sister over there is giving me evil looks again.
